svg.aria-label: BCBC 2024 Article 9.23.13.6 Materials in Braced Wall Panels
svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.23.13.6 Materials in Braced Wall Panels
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.23 WOOD-FRAME CONSTRUCTION
Materials in Braced Wall Panels

g.text: Stacked bands: wood-sheathed panels not above
in place of a GWB panel
Total length based on the GWB framing

svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
Required braced wall panels are
(a) sheathed on the exterior side with plywood, OSB, waferboard or
diagonal lumber complying with Subsection 9.23.17. fastened in
accordance with Sentence 9.23.3.5.(3) and finished on the interior
side with gypsum board complying with Subsection 9.29.5., or (b)
sheathed on the interior side or exterior side with gypsum board
complying with Subsection 9.29.5. and fastened in accordance with
Except as provided in Sentences (4) and (5), braced wall bands
are constructed of braced wall panels of the same sheathing
material.
Braced wall panels in basements and crawl spaces are sheathed
with OSB, plywood, waferboard or diagonal lumber
(a) at braced wall band spacing intervals of not more than 15 m,
and (b) under all interior braced wall bands containing
wood-sheathed braced wall panels. (See Note A-9.23.13.6.(3).)
Mixing of braced wall panel framing types is permitted in
stacked braced wall bands, provided that wood-sheathed braced
wall panels are not above any braced wall bands containing
(a) gypsum-sheathed braced wall panels, or (b)
diagonal-lumber-sheathed braced wall panels.
Mixing of braced wall panel framing types is permitted along a
braced wall band within the same storey, provided that
(a) panels of WSP-A or WSP-B framing type are substituted for
panels of a GWB framing type and the total length of all of the
braced wall panels is determined based on the GWB framing type, or
(b) the lengths of the braced wall panels of mixed framing types
are based on accepted engineering principles. (See Note
Drawn: wood-based sheathing in tan, gypsum board in white. In A and B the face is cut back to show the studs. Sizes are illustration only.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.23.13.6. (page 9-191)
